name: std::basic_fstream<CharT,Traits>::close
intro:
Closes the associated file.

Effectively calls rdbuf()->close(). If an error occurs during operation, setstate(failbit) is called.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: This function is called by the destructor of basic_fstream when the stream object goes out of scope and is not usually invoked directly.
